# Surveys & polls

Scales, one-tap polls, a survey runner and builder, and the results.

[NpsScale](#npsscale) · [PollCard](#pollcard) · [SurveyRunner](#surveyrunner) · [SurveyBuilder](#surveybuilder) · [SurveyResults](#surveyresults)

### NpsScale

The standard 0 to 10 scale in three coloured bands: critics (0–6), passives (7–8) and promoters (9–10). RatingScale (five stars), LikertScale (5 or 7 points) and SurveyQuestionInput (the right input for any survey question) live in the same file.

```ts
import { NpsScale, RatingScale, LikertScale, SurveyQuestionInput } from '@/contest/components/SurveyInputs'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `number` |  | The chosen number. |
| `onChange` *(required)* | `(value: number) => void` |  | Called with the number. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  | Locks the scale. |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes. |

```tsx
<NpsScale value={score} onChange={setScore} />
<LikertScale points={7} low="Far too easy" high="Far too hard" value={v} onChange={setV} />
<SurveyQuestionInput question={q} value={answers[q.id]} onChange={(v) => setAnswer(q.id, v)} />
```

- Every scale is a set of real radio buttons: arrow keys move between them and a screen reader hears the ends of the scale.
- `LikertScale` also takes `points` (5 or 7), `low` and `high`.

### PollCard

A one-tap poll for a break: tap an option and the bars open with how everyone voted. Results stay hidden until the person votes.

```ts
import { PollCard } from '@/contest/components/PollCard'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `survey` *(required)* | `Survey` |  | A survey whose first question is a choice. |
| `voted` | `string` |  | The option this person picked, once they voted. |
| `counts` | `Record<string, number>` |  | How many votes each option has. Shown after the vote. |
| `onVote` *(required)* | `(optionId: string) => void` |  | Called with the option that was tapped. |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes. |

```tsx
<PollCard survey={poll} voted={mine} counts={counts} onVote={(id) => submit({ surveyId: poll.id, answers: { q1: id } })} />
```

- The vote cannot be changed. Hiding the results until the vote keeps people from copying the crowd.

### SurveyRunner

A survey one question at a time, with a progress bar and a Skip on every optional question. After the last question, a thank-you screen.

```ts
import { SurveyRunner } from '@/contest/components/SurveyRunner'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `survey` *(required)* | `Survey` |  | The survey to run. |
| `onSubmit` *(required)* | `(answers: Record<string, SurveyAnswer>) => void \| Promise<void>` |  | Called once with every answer when the person finishes. Skipped questions are left out. |
| `thanks` | `ReactNode` |  | Shown on the thank-you screen, for example a link back. |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes. |

```tsx
<SurveyRunner survey={survey} onSubmit={(answers) => submit({ surveyId: survey.id, answers })} />
```

### SurveyBuilder

Builds a short survey from templates or from nothing: six kinds of question, drag to reorder, optional switches. A checker says what hurts answer quality: more than five questions, leading wording, a changed NPS sentence, too few options.

```ts
import { SurveyBuilder } from '@/contest/components/SurveyBuilder'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `survey` *(required)* | `Survey` |  | The survey being built. |
| `onChange` *(required)* | `(survey: Survey) => void` |  | Called with the whole updated survey. |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes. |

```tsx
<SurveyBuilder survey={draft} onChange={setDraft} />
```

- The checks come from `surveyProblems`. Short surveys and neutral words get more honest answers.

### SurveyResults

What the answers say, question by question: the NPS with its bands and trend over the shows, averages and bars for scales and choices, and the open answers as a list.

```ts
import { SurveyResults } from '@/contest/components/SurveyResults'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `survey` *(required)* | `Survey` |  | The survey. |
| `responses` *(required)* | `SurveyResponse[]` |  | All responses. Only this survey's are used. |
| `episodes` | `Episode[]` |  | Names the shows on the trend of an NPS question. |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes. |

```tsx
<SurveyResults survey={survey} responses={responses} episodes={episodes} />
```
